title: Quadrupole coupling
worst_label: largest relative difference over every family
note: (1/6) Σ Q_ij ∂_j W_i of the vector spherical waves W = M + N (Bohren & Huffman's, the axial m = 0 family shown; the difference covers all five families and M − N), PyStratify's closed-form functional against central differences of the 40-digit waves. The regular wave fades with order at this distance and the outgoing one grows.
summary: the quadrupole's coupling to each order against finite differences
aside:
A quadrupole couples to the vector spherical waves $\mathbf{W} = \mathbf{M} + \mathbf{N}$ through

$$\tfrac{1}{6}\sum_{ij} Q_{ij}\,\partial_j W_i,$$

which PyStratify evaluates in closed form; the reference takes central differences of the same waves in 40-digit arithmetic. The axial (m = 0) family is drawn, 47 nm from the centre with k = 0.013 nm⁻¹: the regular wave fades with order, the outgoing one grows. The test covers all five families.
